text:
Alex: Morning — I'm taking the 07:00 UTC handoff. Quick summary: canary for /v2/embeddings landed to dedicated-pool-7 last night. p50 +12ms, p95 stable, no 5xx. Watch host g-12a for memory pressure (saw one spike to 78%).
Maria: noted. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/intern/d/embeds?orgId=1. Also we enabled small-input prefetch for 2h to evaluate cache hit rate; that can increase KV eviction. If eviction >4% for 10m, alert and @notify.
Sam: i'm on the overnight shift 00:00-08:00 UTC tonight — I'll watch evictions and perf. If mem >85% on g-12a I'll trigger node scale or rollback prefetch.
Alex: action items: 1) Sam monitor key_eviction_rate and reply here if trend up 2) Maria open a follow-up ticket with perf graphs (INT-4321) 3) Alex monitor g-12a mem and tracer for kv-miss spikes 4) deploy-bot to schedule the next canary reminder at 03:00 UTC.
Maria: small CI FYI — flaky integ test slowed last night's deploy; unrelated to runtime but might delay next canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2781.
Sam: preparing a short rollback command for prefetch in case we need it quickly. Posting here in case someone is oncall and needs it:
```
# rollback prefetch flag
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/flags/prefetch -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"enabled":false}'
```
Alex: good. i'll also keep an eye on tracer service 'kv-client' for a sustained 2x baseline of misses (15m) — escalate to eng-infra if we hit that.
Maria: deploy-bot: can you create a one-off ephemeral alert: key_eviction_rate > 4% for 10m -> notify Alex, Sam, Maria?
deploy-bot: ephemeral alert created: key_eviction_rate_over_4pct -> notify [Alex, Sam, Maria]. Next canary reminder set for 03:00 UTC.
Sam: thanks — will ack and add a console bookmark. Also pinging @eng-infra if we need a temporary node: @eng-infra any headroom tonight on dedicated-pool-7?
Alex: if you see memory trend cross 82% for >10m, scale to +1 node for the pool (manual) and note it in the ticket.
Maria: added follow-up checklist in INT-4321: include perf graphs, CI artifact, and rollback steps.
Sam: thumbs up, leaving a quick checklist here for whoever takes the next handoff: 1) check grafana link 2) check ephemeral alert status 3) verify canary pipeline for 03:00 4) confirm prefetch flag state.
Alex: :thumbsup: I'm logging a short note in the handoff doc and then handing off to oncall rotation. DM me if anything noisy pops up.
Maria: thanks — I'll monitor the ticket and keep this thread updated if CI affects rollout.
Sam: will post final check at 23:45 UTC before I start.
Alex: end of thread — handoff handed to Sam at 07:05 UTC.
